{{Quote|It wasn't so bad that I got caught, but the fact that all I got to do was kiss her really bothers me.|Beeyon Nace|<ref name="GG7" />}}
'''Beeyon Nace''' was once an aspiring logistics clerk on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After being caught with the [[Governor/Legends|Governor's]] daughter, he was sent to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] where he served as an assistant to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]]. His duties included logging the incoming and outgoing [[Starship/Legends|ships]] at the local [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Nace was also known to have frequently visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]].<ref name="GG7" />

He was once blackmailed by the [[Ccalras Corporation]] when his lover [[Eila]] betrayed him. After a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] rescued her, they chased off the thugs and they sought shelter with [[Abbot]] [[Drayk]].<ref name="Vested Interest">{{WEGCite|story=Vested Interest|book=Mos Eisley Adventure Set}}</ref>
